decisions.quote: In contrast to the original PEERS study, the current study did not find that friendship quality significantly improved in the experimental treatment group. Upon closer examination, in the original PEERS study, the significant friendship quality finding was due to the waitlist control group demonstrating worse friendship quality over time (Laugeson et al. 2009).
decisions.reason: Although the study replicated improvements in social skills knowledge and hosted get-togethers from Laugeson et al. (2009), the authors explicitly contrast their nonsignificant results for friendship quality and parent-rated social skills with the original study's significant findings, resulting in a mixed outcome.
